verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover near-real-time database replication into BigQuery, scheduled batch data transfers, Pub/Sub streaming subscriptions, and Dataform for the ELT transformation step. ODBC/JDBC drivers give external tooling a documented connection path. One older community comment says getting Cloud SQL data into BigQuery was hard and needed a third-party tool, which tempers the database story. Missing for 10: evidence of SaaS application connectors, a named partner/ETL connector ecosystem (e.g., third-party ELT vendors), source coverage breadth, per-connector setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
